caption: FIGURE 1.33
note: text_layer was null; all text read directly from the crop image. Labels are listed top-left to bottom-right. The track labels "1", "2" and "3" are printed as numerals enclosed in small circles on the artwork; the circle is drawn, not a text character, so only the numeral is given. The rows of plus and minus signs are the printed charge markings on the upper and lower plates respectively (nine signs in each row, as printed); each row is given as a single label because it is one printed run of signs. Structure lost in the flat list: "y" and "x" are axis labels of a small coordinate key at the right of the figure and are a different kind of label from the three track numbers and the two plate charge rows; the schema cannot record that grouping or role. Excluded as outside target_box_in_crop: the surrounding exercise text (items 1.14, 1.15, 1.16, 1.17) above and below the figure, and the faint "NCERT not to be republished" watermark across the page.
